observations.observation: Query requested entity home, but retrieval returned work/Paris first and answered incorrectly.
As-of 2026-01-05 query returned Paris despite Berlin being valid at that date.
As-of 2026-01-05 query returned a future-effective Paris record instead of Berlin.
Query for entity primary returned a newer project-6/Bath record instead of primary/Berlin.

hypothesis: Enabling entity filtering and time-aware retrieval will remove cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested validity interval, improving complete-scenario success.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor cases should select the requested entity, while historical and future-effective queries should return the record valid at the requested as-of date. Storage and write behavior should remain unchanged.
